title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Cancellation Notice and Base-Fee Retention
content:
For each Northgate Delivery & Installation service level, two terms govern what a cancelled appointment returns: the calendar days that must separate the cancellation request from the booked delivery date for every fee to be refunded, and whether a cancellation without that notice keeps the base delivery fee.

| Service level | Notice for a full refund of every fee | Base delivery fee kept on a cancellation without that notice |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | 1 calendar day | No |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | 1 calendar day | Yes |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 2 calendar days | Yes |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 2 calendar days | Yes |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | 2 calendar days | Yes |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | 2 calendar days | Yes |

## Notes

- The notice runs from the cancellation request to the booked delivery date, in calendar days.
- Northgate Curbside Delivery is the only level whose base delivery fee is not kept on a cancellation without notice.
- **Hypothetical dates.** For a delivery booked on the 20th, a request on the 18th leaves 2 calendar days and a request on the 19th leaves 1.
